name: Dip at a section turn
visual_intent: Let the viewer feel a new section start: content leaves, the stage breathes for a quarter second, the next title lands on the first word of the next phrase.

parameters.name: hold
parameters.description: Seconds of empty stage (0.15-0.4; never over 0.5 under narration)

parameters.name: entrance
parameters.description: rise, or none when the caller types the title in

timeline_requirements.gsap_instance: Timeline passed to Studio.build(builder) (registered as window.__timelines['root'])
timeline_requirements.timing_anchors: Cue map (Studio.cues) or word times (Studio.cues.fromWords); snap each move to the word it illustrates

fallbacks: Studio.crossfade for an ordinary scene change; a dip belongs at section turns only.
